descriptions.preferred: Acer shirasawanum 'Purple Umbrella' 紫伞 紫伞是Crispin Silva发现并引进的叶形较大的白泽槭品种，新长出来的叶子大且呈伞状，叶子有对称的、宽阔的拱形裂片。春天叶子呈深紫色、紫红色，后续紫色慢慢蜕变成古铜色，但是叶边缘为紫色，色彩非常迷幻，秋天的颜色通常是鲜红色到深色。成年高度大约在2.5-3m左右。

products.title: Acer shirasawanum 'Purple Umbrella' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer shirasawanum 'Purple Umbrella' Red Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Purple Umbrella’ is a large leaf selection of red full moon Japanese maple that was found and introduced by Crispin Silva. The leaves on the new growth of this Japanese maple can be quite large and umbrella-like. ‘Purple Umbrella’ leafs out as a dark purple maroon. An emerald cast comes into the leaf. Fall color is typically a bright red to deep maroon. We would expect ‘Purple Umbrella’ to reach 8-10 ft in height in 10 years.
